يستغفروا (form X)
# يَسْتَغْفِرُوا (yastaḡfirū) /jas.taɣ.fi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْفَرَ (istaḡfara)
# يُسْتَغْفَرُوا (yustaḡfarū) /jus.taɣ.fa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْفَرَ (istaḡfara)
